traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Wikipedia, Marsileaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves rise from nodes along a long creeping rhizome; Marsilea (45-65 spp.) is most of the order. Wikipedia, Salvinia: leaves in whorls of three (about 12 spp.); Azolla alternate.

traits.rosette.note: Wikipedia, Marsileaceae and Salvinia (read 2026-10-16): creeping rhizomes or floating stems; no rosettes.
